{{Top}}
{{Quote|Do it and I'll blast your choobies all across the back wall.|[[Karl Mathieu Ancher]]|<ref name="Out of the Cradle">{{JournalCite|2|Out of the Cradle}}</ref>}}
'''Choobies''' was a colloquial term used to refer to one's self or one's rear end,<ref name="Star's End">''[[Han Solo at Stars' End]]''</ref><ref name="Guide">''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe]]''</ref> e.g. "pull our choobies out of the conflagration."<ref name="Star's End" /> The phrase "pain in the choobies" was an expression used for something that caused discomfort or was otherwise troublesome.<ref name="Dark Forces 4">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20050526a|series=The Dark Forces Saga|text=Part 4: Of the Crudest Matter}}</ref> 

{{Stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The word is similar to the rude real-world word "ass." 

"Pain in the choobies"<ref name="Dark Forces 4" /> is similar to the real-world offensive idiom "pain in the ass/butt."<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/pain-in-the-ass-butt|text=a pain in the ass/butt|quote=''idiom'' US offensive (UK '''pain in the arse/backside''') someone or something that is very annoying|work=[[Wikipedia:Cambridge University Press and Assessment|''Cambridge Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20230216013148}}</ref>
